revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Two-medic two-chokepoint crossfire. Fang+Vanilla open for DP and early block, then hand off to Noirc[1,6] top and Beagle[4,6] bottom. Kroos[2,6] LEFT fires on both lanes (row1 cols3-6 and row3 cols3-6). Stward[5,6] UP and Popka[4,7] (post-Vanilla) shred the bottom pile; Hibiscus[5,7] UP heals (4,6),(4,7),(5,8); Lancet-2[2,9] LEFT heals top. Melantha[1,7] LEFT adds top burst and catches leakers. All manual skills are banked for the t130-175 flood; Cardigan[5,8] is deployed late as flood-tail backstop. No roadblock tile is ever deployed on; no unsupported mechanic is load-bearing.
